verdict.rationale: Exa's Websets API guide documents real-time HTTP callbacks fired as items are added or enriched, which is a first-party outbound webhook capability a programmatic consumer can receive. Scheduled searches that surface new web events (exa-docs-10) fit the event-subscription use case. The evidence is a single short doc line scoped to Websets, so depth is thin. Missing for 10: documented webhook registration/management endpoints, an event-type catalog, signature verification and retry semantics, webhook coverage beyond Websets, and independent hands-on corroboration.
